INSERT INTO exercises ( id, coach_id, name, description, muscle_group, equipment, video_url, notes, category, movement_pattern, tags, is_custom, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', e.name, e.description, e.muscle_group, e.equipment, e.video_url, e.notes, e.category, e.movement_pattern, e.tags::jsonb, false, now(), now() FROM (VALUES ('Push-Up', 'Classic upper-body pressing movement. Hands shoulder-width, body in a straight line, lower until chest is just above the floor, press back up.', 'chest', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IODxDxX7oi4', 'Scale with knee push-ups or feet elevated.', 'bodyweight', 'horizontal_push', '["beginner","home","upper-body"]'), ('Bodyweight Squat', 'Foundational lower-body movement. Feet shoulder-width, sit back and down keeping chest tall, knees tracking over toes.', 'quads', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aclHkVaku9U', 'Aim for thighs parallel or below.', 'bodyweight', 'squat', '["beginner","home","lower-body"]'), ('Glute Bridge', 'Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Drive through heels to lift hips until straight from shoulders to knees. Squeeze glutes at the top.', 'glutes', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wPM8icPu6H8', 'Hold 2s at the top. Progress to single-leg.', 'bodyweight', 'hinge', '["beginner","home","posterior-chain"]'), ('Reverse Lunge', 'Standing tall, step one foot back and lower until both knees are at ~90 degrees, front shin vertical. Push through the front heel to return.', 'quads', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QOVaHwm-Q6U', 'Easier on knees than forward lunges.', 'bodyweight', 'lunge', '["beginner","home","unilateral"]'), ('Plank', 'Forearms on the ground, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Brace the core, squeeze glutes, breathe normally.', 'core', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ASdvN_XEl_c', 'Start with 20-30s holds, build to 60s.', 'timed', 'core_anti_extension', '["beginner","home","core","isometric"]'), ('Mountain Climbers', 'From a high plank, drive knees toward chest alternately at a quick pace. Keep hips low and core tight.', 'core', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nmwgirgXLYM', '30s on, 30s rest. Slow for core, fast for cardio.', 'cardio', 'core_dynamic', '["intermediate","home","cardio","conditioning"]'), ('Bird Dog', 'On hands and knees, extend opposite arm and leg until parallel to floor, hold briefly, return. Spine stays neutral throughout.', 'core', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wiFNA3sqjCA', '8-10 reps per side, controlled tempo.', 'bodyweight', 'core_anti_rotation', '["beginner","home","core","mobility"]'), ('Superman', 'Lie face-down, arms extended overhead. Lift arms, chest, and legs off the floor, squeeze the lower back and glutes, hold 1-2s, lower with control.', 'back', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z6PJMT2y8GQ', '12-15 reps. Pair with planks.', 'bodyweight', 'core_extension', '["beginner","home","back","posterior-chain"]'), ('Dead Bug', 'On back, arms straight up, knees bent 90 degrees. Slowly lower opposite arm and leg while pressing lower back into the ground. Return and switch.', 'core', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4XLEnwUr1d8', '6-8 reps per side, very slow tempo.', 'bodyweight', 'core_anti_extension', '["beginner","home","core","stability"]'), ('Burpees', 'From standing, squat down, kick feet back to a plank, optional push-up, jump feet forward, then explode up into a jump with hands overhead.', 'full_body', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dZgVxmf6jkA', '5-10 reps per round. Step back to scale down.', 'cardio', 'full_body_conditioning', '["intermediate","home","cardio","conditioning"]'),
-- Barbell (strength) ('Barbell Back Squat', 'Bar racked across the upper back, feet shoulder-width. Brace the core, sit down and back until thighs reach parallel, then drive up through mid-foot.', 'quads', 'barbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8PMjqgR8Wa8', 'The king of lower-body lifts. Keep the bar over mid-foot; 4-6 reps for strength, 8-12 for hypertrophy.', 'strength', 'squat', '["barbell","strength","lower-body"]'), ('Barbell Deadlift', 'Hips back, flat back, bar over mid-foot. Take slack out of the bar, then push the floor away, keeping the bar close to the shins and thighs until standing tall.', 'posterior-chain', 'barbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oN8VgSgnhNk', 'Full posterior-chain builder. Reset each rep; never round the lower back under load.', 'strength', 'hinge', '["barbell","strength","posterior-chain"]'), ('Barbell Bench Press', 'Lying on a flat bench, grip just outside shoulder-width. Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows tucked ~45 degrees, then press back to lockout.', 'chest', 'barbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rT7DgCr-3pg', 'Primary horizontal press. Keep shoulder blades retracted and feet planted. Use a spotter for heavy sets.', 'strength', 'horizontal_push', '["barbell","strength","upper-body"]'), ('Barbell Bent-Over Row', 'Hinge to ~45 degrees with a flat back, bar hanging at arms length. Pull the bar to the lower ribs by driving the elbows back, then lower under control.', 'back', 'barbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FWJR5Ve8bnQ', 'Builds a thick mid-back. Avoid using momentum; pause briefly at the top.', 'strength', 'horizontal_pull', '["barbell","strength","back"]'), ('Barbell Overhead Press', 'Standing, bar at the front rack. Brace the core and glutes, press the bar overhead in a straight line, moving the head back then through at lockout.', 'shoulders', 'barbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yEbczj_FGyI', 'Strict standing press builds pressing power and stability. Do not lean back excessively.', 'strength', 'vertical_push', '["barbell","strength","shoulders"]'),
-- Dumbbell (strength) ('Dumbbell Shoulder Press', 'Seated or standing, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward. Press overhead until arms are nearly locked, then lower with control to ear level.', 'shoulders', 'dumbbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qEwKCR5JCog', 'Allows a natural pressing path and even side-to-side strength. 8-12 reps.', 'strength', 'vertical_push', '["dumbbell","strength","shoulders"]'), ('Dumbbell Bicep Curl', 'Standing, dumbbells at your sides, palms forward. Curl the weights toward the shoulders keeping elbows pinned, then lower slowly.', 'biceps', 'dumbbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XE_pHwbst04', 'Avoid swinging. Squeeze at the top; a slow eccentric adds size.', 'strength', 'elbow_flexion', '["dumbbell","strength","arms"]'), ('Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift', 'Dumbbells in front of the thighs, soft knees. Push the hips back, sliding the weights down the legs until a hamstring stretch, then drive the hips forward.', 'hamstrings', 'dumbbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KYIJdN2gBmQ', 'Targets hamstrings and glutes. Keep a flat back and the weights close to the body.', 'strength', 'hinge', '["dumbbell","strength","posterior-chain"]'), ('Dumbbell Lateral Raise', 'Standing, dumbbells at your sides, slight bend in the elbows. Raise the weights out to the sides until arms are parallel to the floor, then lower slowly.', 'shoulders', 'dumbbell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y29xKcze8Ik', 'Isolates the side delts for width. Use lighter weight and strict form; lead with the elbows.', 'strength', 'lateral_raise', '["dumbbell","strength","shoulders"]'),
-- Machine / Cable (strength) ('Lat Pulldown', 'Seated with thighs secured, grip the bar wider than shoulders. Pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down and back, then return under control.', 'back', 'cable', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CAwf7n6Luuc', 'Great vertical-pull builder and a lead-in to pull-ups. Avoid leaning back excessively.', 'strength', 'vertical_pull', '["cable","machine","back"]'), ('Leg Press', 'Seated in the machine, feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower the sled until knees reach ~90 degrees, then press back without locking the knees hard.', 'quads', 'machine', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K5n2vg3oZa4', 'Loads the legs with a supported back. Do not let the lower back round off the pad at the bottom.', 'strength', 'squat', '["machine","strength","lower-body"]'), ('Cable Tricep Pushdown', 'Facing a high cable with a bar or rope, elbows pinned to your sides. Extend the arms down until straight, squeeze the triceps, then return slowly.', 'triceps', 'cable', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_w-HpW70nSQ', 'Keep the elbows still; only the forearms move. 10-15 reps for a strong pump.', 'strength', 'elbow_extension', '["cable","strength","arms"]'),
-- Cardio / Kettlebell / Mobility ('Kettlebell Swing', 'Hinge at the hips with the bell hiked between the legs, then snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height. Let it fall and repeat rhythmically.', 'glutes', 'kettlebell', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8GpQ66AAKU0', 'Explosive hip-hinge for power and conditioning. Power comes from the hips, not the arms.', 'cardio', 'hinge', '["kettlebell","conditioning","posterior-chain"]'), ('Rowing Machine', 'Drive with the legs first, then lean back slightly and pull the handle to the lower ribs. Reverse the order to return: arms, body, then legs.', 'full_body', 'rowing machine', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4zWu1yuJ0_g', 'Low-impact full-body cardio. Aim for a strong leg drive and a smooth stroke rate.', 'cardio', 'horizontal_pull', '["cardio","conditioning","full-body"]'), ('Cat-Cow Stretch', 'On hands and knees, alternate between arching the spine and dropping the belly (cow) and rounding the spine toward the ceiling (cat), moving with the breath.', 'spine', 'none', 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xyNwxiuERXc', 'Gentle spinal mobility drill; ideal for warm-ups or between sets. Move slowly with the breath.', 'mobility', 'spinal_mobility', '["mobility","warm-up","recovery"]') ) AS e(name, description, muscle_group, equipment, video_url, notes, category, movement_pattern, tags) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM exercises x WHERE x.coach_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND x.name = e.name AND x.deleted_at IS NULL );

INSERT INTO workout_sections (id, coach_id, name, section_type, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES -- Workout 1: Full Body Starter ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000001', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Warm-Up', 'WARM_UP', 'Light dynamic prep to raise the heart rate.', now(), now()), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000002', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Main Strength', 'MAIN', 'Compound push, squat and lunge work.', now(), now()), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000003', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Cool-Down', 'COOL_DOWN', 'Core hold to finish.', now(), now()), -- Workout 2: Core & Stability ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000004', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Activation', 'WARM_UP', 'Spinal stability activation.', now(), now()), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000005', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Core Circuit', 'MAIN', 'Anti-extension and posterior-chain circuit.', now(), now()), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000006', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Cool-Down', 'COOL_DOWN', 'Core hold to finish.', now(), now()), -- Workout 3: HIIT Conditioning ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000007', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Warm-Up', 'WARM_UP', 'Raise the heart rate before intervals.', now(), now()), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000008', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Conditioning Finisher', 'FINISHER', 'High-intensity full-body finisher.', now(), now());

INSERT INTO workouts (id, coach_id, name, description, estimated_duration_minutes, tags, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000001', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Full Body Starter', 'A beginner-friendly full-body session covering push, squat and lunge patterns.', 30, '["beginner","full-body","home"]'::jsonb, now(), now()), ('44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000002', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'Core & Stability', 'Targeted core and stability work to build a strong, resilient midsection.', 25, '["core","stability","home"]'::jsonb, now(), now()), ('44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000003', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', 'HIIT Conditioning', 'A short, sweaty conditioning finisher to build work capacity.', 20, '["hiit","cardio","conditioning"]'::jsonb, now(), now());

INSERT INTO workout_section_exercises (id, section_id, exercise_id, position, sets, reps, duration_seconds, rest_seconds, notes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), s.section_id, (SELECT id FROM exercises x WHERE x.coach_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND x.name = s.exercise_name AND x.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.created_at LIMIT 1), s.position, s.sets, s.reps, s.duration_seconds, s.rest_seconds, s.notes, now(), now() FROM (VALUES -- Full Body Starter: warm-up ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000001'::uuid, 'Mountain Climbers', 0, 2, NULL::int, 30, 20, 'Steady pace to warm up.'), -- Full Body Starter: main ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000002'::uuid, 'Push-Up', 0, 3, 12, NULL, 60, NULL), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000002'::uuid, 'Bodyweight Squat', 1, 3, 15, NULL, 60, NULL), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000002'::uuid, 'Reverse Lunge', 2, 3, 10, NULL, 60, '10 reps per leg.'), -- Full Body Starter: cool-down ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000003'::uuid, 'Plank', 0, 3, NULL, 40, 30, 'Hold with braced core.'), -- Core & Stability: activation ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000004'::uuid, 'Bird Dog', 0, 2, 10, NULL, 20, '10 per side.'), -- Core & Stability: circuit ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000005'::uuid, 'Dead Bug', 0, 3, 8, NULL, 30, '8 per side.'), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000005'::uuid, 'Superman', 1, 3, 12, NULL, 30, NULL), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000005'::uuid, 'Glute Bridge', 2, 3, 15, NULL, 45, NULL), -- Core & Stability: cool-down ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000006'::uuid, 'Plank', 0, 3, NULL, 45, 30, 'Hold with braced core.'), -- HIIT Conditioning: warm-up ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000007'::uuid, 'Mountain Climbers', 0, 2, NULL, 30, 20, NULL), -- HIIT Conditioning: finisher ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000008'::uuid, 'Burpees', 0, 4, 10, NULL, 45, NULL), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000008'::uuid, 'Mountain Climbers', 1, 4, NULL, 30, 30, NULL), ('33333333-3333-3333-3333-000000000008'::uuid, 'Bodyweight Squat', 2, 4, 20, NULL, 45, 'Fast tempo.') ) AS s(section_id, exercise_name, position, sets, reps, duration_seconds, rest_seconds, notes);

INSERT INTO programs (id, coach_id, name, description, duration_days, weeks, modality, experience_level, tags, cover_gradient, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-000000000001', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '4-Week Foundation', 'A four-week bodyweight foundation building strength, core control and conditioning three days a week.', 28, 4, 'Bodyweight', 'Beginner', '["beginner","bodyweight","strength"]'::jsonb, 'linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1, #8b5cf6)', now(), now()), ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-000000000002', '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001', '2-Week Core Focus', 'A short two-week block to build midline stability and a stronger core.', 14, 2, 'Bodyweight', 'Beginner', '["core","stability","bodyweight"]'::jsonb, 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981, #14b8a6)', now(), now());

INSERT INTO program_days (id, program_id, day_number, workout_id, notes, created_at, updated_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), p.program_id, gs.day_number, CASE (gs.day_number % 7) WHEN 1 THEN '44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000001'::uuid -- Mon: Full Body Starter WHEN 2 THEN '44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000002'::uuid -- Tue: Core & Stability WHEN 3 THEN '44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000003'::uuid -- Wed: HIIT Conditioning WHEN 4 THEN '44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000001'::uuid -- Thu: Full Body Starter WHEN 5 THEN '44444444-4444-4444-4444-000000000002'::uuid -- Fri: Core & Stability ELSE NULL -- Sat/Sun: rest END, CASE (gs.day_number % 7) WHEN 1 THEN 'Full body' WHEN 2 THEN 'Core' WHEN 3 THEN 'HIIT' WHEN 4 THEN 'Full body' WHEN 5 THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Rest' END, now(), now() FROM (VALUES ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-000000000001'::uuid, 28), ('55555555-5555-5555-5555-000000000002'::uuid, 14) ) AS p(program_id, total_days) CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(1, p.total_days) AS gs(day_number);

delete.where: coach_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND name IN ( 'Push-Up','Bodyweight Squat','Glute Bridge','Reverse Lunge','Plank', 'Mountain Climbers','Bird Dog','Superman','Dead Bug','Burpees', 'Barbell Back Squat','Barbell Deadlift','Barbell Bench Press', 'Barbell Bent-Over Row','Barbell Overhead Press', 'Dumbbell Shoulder Press','Dumbbell Bicep Curl','Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift', 'Dumbbell Lateral Raise','Lat Pulldown','Leg Press','Cable Tricep Pushdown', 'Kettlebell Swing','Rowing Machine','Cat-Cow Stretch' )
